post.summary: Posts an external alert against a client for the service provider.

get.summary:
Lists agent (managed device) assets for the service provider using cursor pagination.
Results are sorted by `createdOn` descending (newest first).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Clamped to 1–200 (default 50).

get.summary:
Lists tickets for the service provider using cursor pagination.
Default sort is `updatedOn desc`. sortBy accepts only
`updatedOn` or `createdOn`; sortOrder accepts only
`asc` or `desc` (case-insensitive) — any other value is rejected with a 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Clamped to 1–200 (default 50).

public-cluster_CreatePublicClientCommand.description: Request body for creating a client, along with its default location.

ClientId.description: Identifier of the client the contact belongs to. Required.

CreatedByName.description: Display name to record as the ticket creator when no contact is resolved.

ClientId.description: Identifier of the client the ticket belongs to.

LocationId.description: Identifier of the client location the ticket belongs to.

ContactId.description: Identifier of the primary contact for the ticket.

WatcherIds.description: Identifiers of technicians watching the ticket.

SendTicketCreatedEmail.description: When true, sends a "ticket created" email to the contact. Defaults to false.

IsUnread.description: Whether the ticket is created in an unread state. Defaults to true.

Request body for creating a ticket. The owning service provider is resolved from the

TraceId.description: Request correlation id. Quote this when reporting a problem.

for the returned page.
